and bug fixes

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! 30 NEW MATH LEVELS!!!
notes.notes:
WHATS DONE ?

Now you can choose with grade levels you wanna play and with subject for example first grade gonna have math, language and world understanding, later maybe gonna add more 

Done 30 math level for both English and Lithuanian languages

Fixed problem entering levels room loading taking long, no its faster

Fixed problem where playing Lithuanian levels you unlock levels in English language aswell



If you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better leave comment!

notes.title: Dev Update-POWER UPS, SAVE PROGRESS AND MORE!
notes.notes:
Happy to announce i added new things to the game here list 



Save and load system-  So now game gonna save and load progress automatically

Power ups- added power ups freezing opponent snail, scaring with bird sound and wind

Pressing wrong answer now gonna make snail move little bit back

fixed bug where player can start answering questions before countdown



if you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better leave comment!

notes.title: Dev update-Snail Shop!
notes.notes:
New update!



Now in game we have SNAIL SHOP where you can buy diffirent looking snails!

Done score(money) system everytime finishing level you will get 1 score(money) and you can spend that money on diffirent looking snails in future will add more stuff where you can spend in game money

if you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better please comment :)
